records.name: Anthony E. Munroe
records.notes: ECC's 8th president; departed effective Oct. 1, 2020 to become president of Borough of Manhattan Community College. Start year 2015 is approximate.

records.name: Augustine A. Boakye
records.priorTitle: Acting/Interim President (previously Associate Professor of Economics and Division Chair)
records.notes: ECC's 9th president. Began as acting/interim president July 21, 2020, following Munroe's departure; appointed to the permanent role by the Board of Trustees Nov. 1, 2021. Inaugurated May 5, 2022 (per essex.edu). Internal hire, started at ECC as an associate professor in 2009.

records.name: Marie-Elaine Burns
records.notes: Approved by Peralta Community College District trustees as permanent president effective May 10, 2017; served until David Johnson's appointment in 2020.

records.name: David M. Johnson
records.priorTitle: Vice President of Instruction (and Acting President from late 2019)
records.notes: Joined Merritt as VP of Instruction in Jan. 2019, became Acting President in late 2019, and was named permanent President in June 2020. Still serving as of 2026 per Peralta Gems President's Reports.

records.name: Nate Essex
records.notes: Retired effective June 30, 2015; preceded Tracy D. Hall.

records.name: Tracy D. Hall
records.notes: Assumed office July 13, 2015 and continues to serve as of 2026 (elected to SACSCOC board 2020, AACC board 2022).

records.name: Warren Nichols
records.notes: Vol State's 2nd president, per the college's 50th-anniversary presidential timeline (Hal Ramer 1970-2003, Nichols 2003-2011, Faulkner 2012-2021, Montague 2021-2023).

records.name: Jerry Faulkner
records.notes: Approved by TBR March 21, 2012, began May 15, 2012; announced retirement after roughly nine years.

records.name: Orinthia Montague
records.notes: Succeeded Faulkner in 2021; departed 2023, prompting the search that led to Tostenson.

records.name: Wendi W. Tostenson
records.priorTitle: Vice Chancellor of Education and Student Services
records.notes: Appointed by the Tennessee Board of Regents; became Vol State's 5th (some counts say 6th, including interims) president effective July 1, 2024. Honored with the Paragon Award in 2025.

records.name: John J. Sbrega
records.notes: Third president of BCC (after founding president Eileen Farley, 1978-2000); served through 2017.

records.name: Laura L. Douglas
records.notes: BCC's fourth president; served 2017-2025, preceding Sedgwick Harris.

records.name: Sedgwick L. Harris
records.notes: Took office March 3, 2025 as BCC's fifth president in its 60-year history; inaugurated in 2025 per college news release.

records.name: Steve Daniel
records.priorTitle: Provost / Vice President of Economic Development
records.notes: President of West Georgia Technical College since 2014; had been with the Georgia technical college system since 2003.

records.name: Julie Post
records.notes: Appointed by TCSG; began duties at West Georgia Tech on April 16, 2021. Continues to serve as of 2026 (presided over spring/summer 2026 commencements).

records.name: Matt Gotschall
records.priorTitle: President, Columbus Campus (also held district administrative roles)
records.notes: Became CCC president in January 2018 after 12 years leading the Columbus campus; internal promotion. His immediate predecessor as district president could not be confirmed from available sources. Still serving as of 2026 (received the Impact Award and an EDAD honor at UNL in Nov. 2025).

records.name: Daniel Peck
records.notes: Served as Mission College (West Valley-Mission CCD) president July 2013-January 2022. Interim leaders Norma Ambriz-Galaviz (Feb-June 2022) and Danny Nguyen (July 2022, acting) bridged the gap before Awan started.

records.name: Seher Awan
records.notes: Mission College's 12th president; started August 1, 2022. Previously led Los Angeles Southwest College since 2018; described as the youngest sitting president in the California Community College system.

records.name: Tim McDonald
records.priorTitle: Executive Vice President (interim president from Dec. 2020)
records.notes: Lanier Tech's 8th president; served as interim starting December 2020 and was made permanent April 1, 2021, after a 37-year career at the college rising from Machine Tool Technology instructor. His immediate predecessor (7th president) could not be confirmed from available sources.

records.name: Jackie Vietti
records.notes: Long-serving Butler CC president 1995-2012; later returned briefly as interim in 2025.

records.name: Kimberly Krull
records.notes: Served after Karla Fisher's interim year (2012-2013); led Butler CC for over a decade through 2025.

records.name: Tamara Daniel
records.notes: Became president in 2025, after Jackie Vietti briefly returned as interim president in 2025 between Krull and Daniel.

seats.university: City Colleges of Chicago-Harry S Truman College

records.name: Shawn L. Jackson
records.notes: Current president of Truman College (one of the seven City Colleges of Chicago); previously spent 15 years in Chicago Public Schools as teacher, principal, and district administrator. Exact start date and immediate predecessor could not be confirmed from available sources -- flagged as a research gap.

records.name: Daniel Howard
records.priorTitle: Vice Chancellor for Academic Affairs / Interim Chancellor
records.notes: Became LSUA chancellor in March 2014, arriving from Arkansas State University; preceded by Paul Coreil's first (interim) stint from 2013.

records.name: Paul Coreil
records.notes: Returned to lead LSUA as Chancellor starting 2019 (had earlier served as interim chancellor from 2013); announced retirement in a March 5, 2026 campus article, with Elizabeth Beard succeeding him July 1, 2026.

records.name: Elizabeth Beard
records.priorTitle: Provost and Vice Chancellor for Academic Affairs
records.notes: Began service as Chancellor of LSUA on July 1, 2026, promoted internally from Provost/Vice Chancellor for Academic Affairs, succeeding Paul Coreil.

records.name: Jenni Martin
records.priorTitle: Vice President of Instruction (Acting President before permanent appointment)
records.notes: 25-year veteran of SCC (part of the Community Colleges of Spokane district); served as Acting President before becoming permanent President in July 2024. Her immediate predecessor as permanent president could not be confirmed from available sources -- flagged as a research gap.

records.name: Stephanie Bulger
records.notes: Current president of Lane Community College per the college's own listing. Founding president was Dr. Dale Parnell (institution's first president, honored with the Dale P. Parnell Center dedicated Oct. 2018). Exact start date and immediate predecessor for Bulger could not be confirmed from available sources -- flagged as a research gap.

records.name: Thomas A. Isekenegbe
records.notes: Long-serving BCC president through 2025, preceding Larry Johnson.

records.name: Larry Johnson
records.notes: Began serving as Bronx Community College (CUNY) president with his first official day and a town hall on/around July 21, 2025; described as a nationally known equity-focused community college leader, with a '100-Day Presidential Road Map' built on Belonging, Collaboration, and Communication.

records.name: Kevin Horan
records.priorTitle: Vice President of Instruction and Student Services
records.priorInstitution: Los Medanos College (Contra Costa Community College District)
records.notes: Appointed as the ninth president of Crafton Hills College (San Bernardino CCD) in January 2019; spent 13 years with the Contra Costa Community College District beforehand, including 7 years as VP of Instruction and Student Services at Los Medanos College. His immediate (8th) predecessor could not be confirmed from available sources.

records.name: Michael J. McDonough
records.priorTitle: Provost and Vice President of Academic Services
records.notes: RVCC's eighth president; started June 2014 after serving as Provost/VP of Academic Services (2011-2014) and Dean of Liberal Arts (2007-2011) at Monroe Community College in Rochester, NY. His immediate (7th) predecessor could not be confirmed from available sources.

records.name: Jeannie Worden
records.notes: Current president of Northcentral Technical College per the college's own website. Exact start date, prior role, and immediate predecessor could not be confirmed from available sources -- flagged as a research gap.
